subject: Budget range validation - monthly spend band & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Budget range validation - monthly spend band & procurement thresholds

Hi Ava — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align pricing and procurement next steps.

Recap from our call:
- Workload: customer-facing chat + periodic embeddings for search/reranking.
- Token mix: expect ~80% chat completions, ~20% embeddings.
- Target deployment: hosted/dedicated evaluation initially, then Dedicated if throughput warrants.
- Expected volume (your ballpark): ~100~150M tokens/month.

Pricing / qualification asks (to confirm):
1) Can you confirm a tighter monthly spend band (we used 100~150M on the call, but any low/high estimates help)?
2) Target unit economics — what range would be acceptable for $/1M tokens for a pilot vs production? (e.g., pilot discounts, target enterprise target $/1M)
3) Procurement thresholds: what internal approval/PO/contract thresholds should we plan for? (e.g., PO required for >$10k, legal review for >$100k, etc.)

If you can reply with the three items above, I’ll send a short mutual action plan + SOW draft for a pilot. I can also propose a pilot price that lets you validate model quality while limiting upfront spend.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

From: Ava Roberts <ava@novalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - monthly spend band & procurement thresholds

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and the clear recap. A few answers below to keep things concrete.

1) Monthly volume: we expect ~120M tokens/month in steady state. For the pilot we’d probably start smaller (20~40M/month) and scale.
2) Unit economics: for production we’re targeting roughly $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens. For a short pilot (1~3 months) we could accept a pilot rate in the $600/1M tokens range if there’s a usage cap.
3) Procurement thresholds (Novalytics):
   - PO required for vendor onboarding at any amount, but a PO under $10k can be handled by the dev org.
   - Finance approval required for committed spend >$50k/month.
   - Legal review kicks in for contracts/commitments over $100k total (one-time or annualized).

Procurement contact: Michael Thompson (cc’d) will own the PO/timing and internal approval path. He can share typical timelines — we usually need 2~3 weeks for PO + standard vendor review.

If you can share a draft SOW and an example pilot price for the 3-month/20~40M monthly band, I’ll route to procurement and loop Michael.

Thanks — Ava

--

Thanks Ava — really helpful. I’ve attached a short SOW draft (Novalytics_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf) and a proposed mutual action plan. Summary of the pricing proposal:

Pilot proposal (3 months):
- Pilot duration: 3 months
- Month 1: up to 20M tokens at $600 per 1M tokens (pilot discounted rate)
- Months 2~3: up to 40M tokens/month at $700 per 1M tokens
- Overage: $900 per 1M tokens beyond capped amounts during pilot (to avoid surprise spend)

Production baseline (post-pilot, subject to volume):
- 100~150M tokens/month band: $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens (volume tiering to be finalized based on actual token mix)

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll upload the SOW & MAP to the HubSpot/Drive link and share with procurement.
- Marissa to introduce account exec + legal to Michael for PO timeline and contract questions.
- Schedule a 30-min contract alignment next week if Michael/finance/legal want to meet.

Attachments: Novalytics_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (draft, stub)

Can you confirm whether Michael needs any vendor forms or W9/PO templates up front? We’ll get those ready so procurement can move quickly.

Thanks — Marissa
